cohort: The study included all births (n=6235) that met inclusion criteria from January to June in 2020 and 2021 in a large tertiary maternity service.
finding: Carbetocin was associated with significantly lower average blood loss and reduced rates of moderate and severe PPH compared to Oxytocin.
mod_finding: Carbetocin was associated with reduced odds of PPH for both vaginal and caesarean births.
